specs.summary: Outer Tau ingress schema contract for relayable clearinghouse perps actions.

control_inputs.name: module_ok
control_inputs.meaning: host projected module name matches the expected perps module

control_inputs.name: market_id_ok
control_inputs.meaning: host projected market identifier is valid

control_inputs.name: version_ok
control_inputs.meaning: host projected version is valid

control_inputs.name: unknown_fields_ok
control_inputs.meaning: host projection removed or rejected unknown fields

control_inputs.name: action_known
control_inputs.meaning: host decoded a supported action kind

control_inputs.name: action_one_hot
control_inputs.meaning: exactly one supported action mode is selected

control_inputs.name: signed_action_selected
control_inputs.meaning: signed action mode is selected

control_inputs.name: oracle_action_selected
control_inputs.meaning: oracle action mode is selected

control_inputs.name: signed_auth_fields_ok
control_inputs.meaning: signed mode auth bundle is present and structurally valid

control_inputs.name: oracle_auth_fields_ok
control_inputs.meaning: oracle mode auth bundle is present and structurally valid

control_inputs.name: host_projection_ok
control_inputs.meaning: host-side projection and envelope decoding succeeded

outputs.name: action_selection_ok
outputs.meaning: action is known and action-mode selection is well-formed

outputs.name: auth_bundle_ok
outputs.meaning: the selected auth mode has the required auth-field bundle

outputs.name: ingress_preconditions_ok
outputs.meaning: module, market, version, unknown-field, and host-projection checks all passed

outputs.name: ingress_schema_ok
outputs.meaning: the full outer ingress schema contract is satisfied

assumptions: The host computes structural facts and action decoding before Tau evaluation.
Tau combines the host-projected booleans fail-closed and does not parse the full action payload itself.

guarantees.description: The guard accepts exactly one supported auth mode when the corresponding auth bundle and preconditions all pass.

forbidden_behaviors.description: The guard rejects when the selected mode lacks its required auth bundle.
The guard rejects malformed action selection and failed host projection.

specs.summary: Boolean Tau gate for the zUSD oracle commit boundary after host projection of environment and policy checks.

control_inputs.name: oracle_seen
control_inputs.meaning: an oracle input has been observed

control_inputs.name: pending_le_active
control_inputs.meaning: pending oracle price is less than or equal to active price

control_inputs.name: fresh_ok
control_inputs.meaning: oracle freshness window is satisfied

control_inputs.name: auth_ok
control_inputs.meaning: oracle commit authorization passed

control_inputs.name: mcr_ok_at_pending
control_inputs.meaning: the projected MCR-at-pending check passed

outputs.name: env_ok
outputs.meaning: oracle seen, pending<=active, and freshness all hold

outputs.name: policy_ok
outputs.meaning: auth and MCR-at-pending policy checks hold

outputs.name: policy_ok_shadow
outputs.meaning: legacy compatibility output mirroring policy_ok

outputs.name: oracle_commit_allowed
outputs.meaning: the full oracle commit guard allows the commit

assumptions: The host computes freshness, pending<=active, and MCR-at-pending booleans before Tau evaluation.
Tau only combines the projected control flags fail-closed.

guarantees.description: The guard allows commit only when both environment and policy checks hold.

forbidden_behaviors.description: The guard rejects when projected environment checks fail.
The guard rejects when projected policy checks fail.

specs.summary: Final Tau transaction-envelope guard for the live autotrader submit path.

control_inputs.name: tx_requested
control_inputs.meaning: live submit path is requesting a Tau transaction

control_inputs.name: sequence_present
control_inputs.meaning: sequence argument is present

control_inputs.name: expiration_present
control_inputs.meaning: expiration argument is present

control_inputs.name: sequence_valid
control_inputs.meaning: sequence argument passed host validation

control_inputs.name: expiration_valid
control_inputs.meaning: expiration argument passed host validation

control_inputs.name: fee_limit_valid
control_inputs.meaning: fee limit passed host validation

control_inputs.name: intent_stream_present
control_inputs.meaning: required intent stream is present

control_inputs.name: settlement_stream_absent
control_inputs.meaning: forbidden settlement stream is absent

control_inputs.name: extra_custom_streams_absent
control_inputs.meaning: no extra custom streams survived projection

outputs.name: tx_args_paired_ok
outputs.meaning: requested tx has paired sequence and expiration arguments

outputs.name: tx_bounds_ok
outputs.meaning: requested tx passed bounds validation

outputs.name: tx_stream_scope_ok
outputs.meaning: requested tx has the correct stream scope

outputs.name: tx_envelope_ok
outputs.meaning: the transaction envelope is admissible

assumptions: The host computes sequence, expiration, and fee validation booleans before Tau evaluation.
Tau only checks the final envelope contract over host-projected booleans.

guarantees.description: The guard allows idle traces and requested txs with a complete valid envelope.

forbidden_behaviors.description: The guard rejects requested txs with missing bounds or wrong stream scope.

specs.summary: Strict sequential nonce guard for live autotrader intents.

data_inputs.name: intent_nonce
data_inputs.meaning: nonce attached to the current intent

outputs.name: params_ok
outputs.meaning: expected nonce equals last_used_nonce + 1

outputs.name: nonce_fresh
outputs.meaning: intent nonce is strictly greater than last used nonce

outputs.name: nonce_sequential
outputs.meaning: intent nonce equals expected nonce

outputs.name: nonce_guard_ok
outputs.meaning: the full sequential nonce guard passes

assumptions: The live submit path uses strict sequential nonces rather than sparse nonces.
Arithmetic stays inside Tau for this compact nonce relation.

guarantees.description: The guard accepts the exact next sequential nonce.

forbidden_behaviors.description: The guard rejects nonsequential or mismatched nonce progress.

specs.summary: Tau admission guard for cross-shard decision certificates after host projection of decision and deadline facts.

control_inputs.name: decision_known
control_inputs.meaning: host decoded a supported cross-shard decision kind

control_inputs.name: decision_one_hot
control_inputs.meaning: host projected exactly one cross-shard decision mode

control_inputs.name: commit_selected
control_inputs.meaning: commit decision mode is selected

control_inputs.name: reject_selected
control_inputs.meaning: reject decision mode is selected

control_inputs.name: pending_selected
control_inputs.meaning: pending decision mode is selected

control_inputs.name: current_step_supplied
control_inputs.meaning: runtime supplied current-step context for cross-shard decision admission

control_inputs.name: decision_step_le_current
control_inputs.meaning: host projected decision_step <= current_step

control_inputs.name: decision_step_le_deadline
control_inputs.meaning: host projected decision_step <= deadline_step

control_inputs.name: pending_created_before_deadline
control_inputs.meaning: host projected decision_step < deadline_step for a pending decision

control_inputs.name: pending_current_before_deadline
control_inputs.meaning: host projected current_step < deadline_step for a pending decision

control_inputs.name: certificate_shape_and_binding_ok
control_inputs.meaning: certificate schema, hashes, participant bindings, receipt-decision pair, and visibility constraints passed runtime checks

outputs.name: decision_selection_ok
outputs.meaning: decision kind is known, one-hot, and exactly one variant flag is selected

outputs.name: deadline_context_ok
outputs.meaning: current-step context exists and decision time is inside current/deadline bounds

outputs.name: pending_deadline_ok
outputs.meaning: non-pending decisions pass; pending decisions are created before and still before deadline

outputs.name: decision_payload_ok
outputs.meaning: host-projected certificate shape and binding checks passed

outputs.name: cross_shard_deadline_admission_ok
outputs.meaning: the full cross-shard deadline admission guard is satisfied

assumptions: The deterministic runtime parses certificates, verifies hashes and participants, and computes integer deadline comparison flags before Tau evaluation.
Tau checks only the host-projected boolean admission contract and fails closed on missing or false flags.
non_goals: Parsing cross-shard decision certificate payloads inside Tau.
Replacing the deterministic Python certificate verifier.

guarantees.description: The guard accepts final and pending decisions only when selection, timing, and payload-binding facts all pass.

forbidden_behaviors.description: Pending decisions cannot be admitted when created at deadline or evaluated at/after deadline.
Decision admission fails closed without current-step context or when the decision is future-dated.
Malformed decision selection or failed certificate binding prevents admission.

specs.summary: Tau admission gate for recursive RISC0 lifecycle asset-delta row certificates.

control_inputs.name: proof_requested
control_inputs.meaning: host requested recursive lifecycle proof admission

control_inputs.name: proof_verified
control_inputs.meaning: RISC0 receipt verification succeeded against the expected image ID

control_inputs.name: proof_profile_supported
control_inputs.meaning: proof profile is a supported recursive leaf or aggregate profile

control_inputs.name: leaf_rows_derived
control_inputs.meaning: host/RISC0 path derived lifecycle rows from checked transition inputs rather than accepting unchecked rows

control_inputs.name: asset_delta_root_bound
control_inputs.meaning: metadata rows recompute to the journal asset_delta_root and header-bound root

control_inputs.name: aggregate_rows_balanced
control_inputs.meaning: recursive aggregate rows satisfy debit plus authorized mint equals credit plus authorized burn

control_inputs.name: authority_roots_allowed
control_inputs.meaning: authorized mint, burn, slash, or reward rows use committed allowed authority roots

control_inputs.name: unsupported_lifecycle_absent
control_inputs.meaning: all lifecycle effects in the proof family are covered by the row extractor or rejected

control_inputs.name: tau_header_binding_ok
control_inputs.meaning: proof metadata roots match the Tau header or admission packet roots

control_inputs.name: transcript_binding_ok
control_inputs.meaning: statement, journal, receipt, and transcript hashes are mutually bound

outputs.name: row_certificate_ok
outputs.meaning: row derivation, row-root binding, and lifecycle coverage checks passed

outputs.name: aggregate_conservation_ok
outputs.meaning: aggregate row balance and authority-root checks passed

outputs.name: proof_binding_ok
outputs.meaning: proof verification, profile, header, and transcript bindings passed

outputs.name: recursive_lifecycle_admissible
outputs.meaning: the recursive lifecycle proof summary is admissible to Tau

assumptions: The deterministic host verifies RISC0 receipts, recomputes lifecycle row roots, checks aggregate row balance, and projects those booleans before Tau evaluation.
Tau combines the projected booleans fail-closed and does not parse RISC0 journals or row payloads itself.
non_goals: Executing the RISC0 transition inside Tau.
Replacing the Rust row extractor or aggregate row conservation checker.

guarantees.description: The gate admits a recursive lifecycle proof only when proof, row, aggregate, authority, and transcript bindings all pass.

forbidden_behaviors.description: Missing derived rows, row-root drift, or unsupported lifecycle effects prevent admission.
Unbalanced aggregate rows or unauthorized authority roots prevent admission.
Receipt, profile, header, or transcript binding failures prevent admission.
